description: This source file defines the EventGeneratorStreamingSilo class responsible for configuring streaming event generators within an Orleans silo. It includes nested classes for configuration parameters and the event generator implementation, as well as related configuration classes such as TimeBoundEventGeneratorConfig and TimeBoundEventGenerator.

classes.name: EventGeneratorStreamingSilo
classes.description: A class implementing ISiloConfigurator to set up streaming event generation with configurable options and stream generator setup.

classes.name: TimeBoundEventGeneratorConfig
classes.description: Configuration class implementing IStreamGeneratorConfig for time-bound event generation settings.

classes.name: TimeBoundEventGenerator
classes.description: Implementation of IStreamGenerator that generates events over a specified time window, producing batches of stream data.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets up Orleans silo builder with streaming configuration and event generator options.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the generator with the provided service provider and configuration parameters.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Generates a list of batch containers representing stream events, based on the current time window.
